rules.name: xoga750-05-trade-id-counter-vs-data
rules.sql: WITH used AS ( SELECT upper(x.business_unit) AS bu, count(*) AS ids_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.suffix ~ '^[0-9]{1,15}$') AS numeric_ids, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.suffix !~ '^[0-9]{1,15}$') AS non_numeric_ids, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.suffix ~ '^0[0-9]+$') AS leading_zero_ids, max(CASE WHEN x.suffix ~ '^[0-9]{1,15}$' THEN x.suffix::bigint END) AS max_suffix, max(length(x.suffix)) AS longest_suffix FROM (SELECT d.business_unit, substr(d.trade_id, length(:fy) + 1) AS suffix FROM opera.deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.trade_id >= :fy AND d.trade_id < :fyEnd) x GROUP BY upper(x.business_unit) ), seq AS ( SELECT upper(s.sequence_criteria ->> 'businessUnit') AS bu, s.last_sequence_id, s.start_value, s.end_value, s.updated_by, s.updated_timestamp FROM opera.oga_transaction_id_sequence_criteria s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant ), val AS ( SELECT upper(v.business_unit) AS bu, v.settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant ), pref AS ( SELECT upper(p.business_unit) AS bu, min(p.trade_id_prefix) AS prefix FROM opera.helper_fetch_tradeid_prefix_view p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY upper(p.business_unit) ), allbu AS (SELECT bu FROM used UNION SELECT bu FROM seq UNION SELECT bu FROM val) SELECT a.bu AS business_unit, pref.prefix AS view_prefix, val.settlement_date, seq.last_sequence_id AS counter_last_id, seq.start_value, seq.end_value, seq.updated_by AS counter_updated_by, seq.updated_timestamp AS counter_updated, coalesce(used.ids_rows, 0) AS ids_rows, coalesce(used.numeric_ids, 0) AS numeric_ids, coalesce(used.non_numeric_ids, 0) AS non_numeric_ids, coalesce(used.leading_zero_ids, 0) AS leading_zero_ids, used.max_suffix, used.longest_suffix, seq.last_sequence_id - used.max_suffix AS gap, CASE WHEN seq.bu IS NULL AND coalesce(used.ids_rows, 0) > 0 THEN 'NO_COUNTER_ROW' WHEN seq.bu IS NULL THEN 'NO_COUNTER_ROW_NO_DATA' WHEN used.max_suffix IS NULL THEN 'NO_DATA' WHEN seq.last_sequence_id - used.max_suffix < -(:guard) THEN 'BEHIND_OVER_GUARD' WHEN seq.last_sequence_id < used.max_suffix THEN 'BEHIND' ELSE 'OK' END AS status FROM allbu a LEFT JOIN used ON used.bu = a.bu LEFT JOIN seq ON seq.bu = a.bu LEFT JOIN val ON val.bu = a.bu LEFT JOIN pref ON pref.bu = a.bu ORDER BY CASE WHEN seq.bu IS NULL AND coalesce(used.ids_rows, 0) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, a.bu

SELECT f.uuid, f.name, f.transaction_type, f.reference_format, f.number_of_digits, f.reset_value, f.periodicity, f.split_sequence, f.transaction_sequence_criteria::text AS criteria_json, f.created_by, f.created_timestamp FROM opera.oga_configservice_transactionidformatmaster f WHERE f.tenant_id = :tenant AND f.transaction_type = 'tradeId' ORDER BY f.created_timestamp DESC

SELECT m.financial_year, m.trade_id_prefix, f.start_date, f.end_date FROM opera.financial_year_trade_id_mapping_table m LEFT JOIN opera.financial_year_table f ON f.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND f.financial_year = m.financial_year WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant ORDER BY f.start_date NULLS LAST, m.financial_year

expect.reason: a counter more than the guard behind its data makes every reservation of that BU fail (seen for CFS on dev at 05:12 UTC on 25 Nov)
a BU with trade ids but no counter row cannot reserve ids; GPC had none
a counter behind its data works but skips used ids one by one on every run
the service reads the newest tradeId format row
